How to build your artwork

  1. Add your photos. Click any panel to choose a picture, or drag one straight onto it. On the strip you can drop all twelve at once.
  2. Position it. Drag inside a photo to move it, scroll to zoom. A short click swaps the photo; a drag moves it. Watch the print quality reading — we'll warn you before anything would print soft.
  3. Write your text. Type in the boxes on the right. Each one has its own colour, size and outline controls.
  4. Move things about. Turn on Move text, then drag the wording or the speech boxes wherever you want them.
  5. Choose your size and output. Poster, or canvas with a standard or gallery wrap. On canvas the dashed line shows the front face — keep faces inside it.
  6. Download a draft to check it over, then add it to your basket.
